= Footnote coverage

An unnamed marker.footnote:[Anonymous note.]

A single definition.footnote:single[Single note.]

A single reference.footnote:single[]

A multiple definition.footnote:multiple[Multiple note.]

Multiple reference one.footnote:multiple[]

Multiple reference two.footnote:multiple[]

== Heading footnote:title[Title note.]

A *formatted footnote:formatted[Formatted note.]*.

* Item footnote:list[List note.]

References footnote:title[], footnote:formatted[], footnote:cell[], and footnote:list[].
